+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M84889267NZRKTE28PXCCCJS
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8480'
+title: 'Inkling 2 decode: trim lm_head to the unpadded vocabulary and fuse the softcap'
+---
+## Why
+- `Inkling2.logits` projects all 201024 rows, ~260 MB of 4-bit weight per token.
+- It then casts to float32, applies tanh softcap 30, and slices to the 200058 unpadded rows, as separate elementwise ops.
+
+## What
+- At load, slice the lm_head quantized weight, scales and biases to the unpadded vocabulary. The weight is shared with the MTP drafter (`vocabularyProjection`), so check that the drafter still works.
+- Fuse the cast and the softcap into one compiled op.
+
+## Acceptance
+- [ ] inklingcheck.sh: CHECK PASS.
+- [ ] inklingbench.sh shows a gain beyond the noise, or the card records the result and reverts.
+- [ ] The MTP draft tests pass. #inkling-perf
\ No newline at end of file
